newsitem.title: USA: U.N. envoy to see Mobutu Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: U.N. envoy to see Mobutu Wednesday.

text.p: U.N. envoy Raymond Chretien said Monday he would meet ailing Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko on the French Riviera on Wednesday and believed the international community was committed to fast action on the Zaire-Rwanda crisis.
Chretien told a news conference he would leave for Nice early Tuesday, see Mobutu, who is resting at his nearby villa, and then meet Zairean Prime Minister Kengo Wa Dondo in Kinshasha.

Chretien, who has discussed Zaire with U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher and other figures, said: "I'm pleasantly surprised there seems to be a great deal of political will (in the international community) to work very fast on the first part of my (U.N.) mandate."
This involves developing urgent plans to defuse the crisis, establishing a ceasefire and a negotiating process.
Chretien is Canada's ambassador to Washington.
